title: typing is archived on PyPI
summary: PyPI marks typing as archived: the project does not expect to be updated in the future.

constraints: Preserve behavior while removing typing; PyPI says the project does not expect to be updated, so it will not receive fixes or support for newer Python releases.

steps.title: Replace typing
steps.instructions: Remove typing from requirements, pyproject.toml, and lock files and replace it with a maintained alternative (often the standard library or the project that superseded it), then update the imports.

verification.purpose: Confirm the installed distributions have no broken requirements.
Run the test suite without the archived distribution.
